description: Source code for the HistoryPage class in Apache Spark, responsible for rendering the history page UI in the Spark History Server, including application listings, logs, and status updates.

classes.name: HistoryPage
classes.description: A web UI page class for displaying Spark application history, including application list, logs, and status updates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the history page based on the HTTP request.

methods.name: shouldDisplayApplications
methods.description: Determines whether to display application listings based on completion status.

methods.name: makePageLink
methods.description: Constructs a URL for toggling between incomplete and complete application views.

methods.name: isApplicationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if a given ApplicationInfo object represents a completed application.
